dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Summary of your evaluations: exploration, level reached, and progress.
dashboard.mindMapIntro: Colours: grey (0 evaluations), blue (fewer than 3), amber (3 to 6), green (more than 6). The number in parentheses is the total evaluations for each path.
dashboard.gaugesIntro: A half-circle gauge per theme, filled according to the weighted average score (out of 100) across its paths. The label and evaluation count show overall exploration.
dashboard.radarIntro: Averages per criterion (relevance, precision, clarity) and overall score, for each path with at least one evaluation.
dashboard.radarLegendHint: Click a path in the legend to open the review.
dashboard.progressionIntro: Points follow chronological order of each evaluation creation date (fallback to id order if a date is missing). Raw score (dashed), 5-evaluation moving average (solid curve), and cumulative average per theme.
dashboard.progressionEmpty: No evaluation recorded yet. Come back after a few sessions!
dashboard.loadError: Could not load dashboard data. Check that the API is reachable.
dashboard.progressionXTitle: Time (creation date of each evaluation, chronological order)

drawing.title: Drawing
drawing.toolbarAria: Drawing tools (drag and drop onto the canvas)
drawing.labelFontSizeHint: Select one or more labels or text objects, then adjust the size.
drawing.labelFontSizeAria: Font size for the selection, from 5 to 24 pixels in steps of 1
drawing.zoomHint: Ctrl (or Cmd) + scroll on the canvas to zoom. Shortcuts: Ctrl + / Ctrl -, Ctrl 0 to reset.
drawing.hint: Drag a tool onto the canvas. Drag from a midpoint handle (top, bottom, left, right) to another shape to create a linked arrow; hold Alt + corner to start from an angle. Polyline arrow: click for each segment, double-click to finish; drag a blue handle to adjust a segment while drawing or after (Escape to cancel). Double-click a shape for a linked label (follows the shape); the Free text tool stays independent. Select one or more labels/text objects to adjust font size with the slider. Delete / Backspace to remove. Use the fullscreen button to enlarge the window. Ctrl + scroll on the canvas to zoom.

adminShell.title: Administration
adminShell.subtitle: Platform settings: learning content, scoring, sources, and future extensions.

challenges.title: Cognitive challenges
challenges.intro: Gamified evaluation framework: cognitive operations, game mechanics, and compatibility matrix aligned with the knowledge pyramid. Challenges are generated from Discover, starting from a question in the learning path.
challenges.mechanicsIntro: Twelve ways to play with ideas: each mechanic gives exercises a different kind of interaction.

matrixLegend.title: Compatibility scores (0 to 3)
matrixLegend.intro: Each cell shows how well a cognitive operation and a game mechanic fit together when designing an exercise. Combinations scored 0 cannot be generated.

dragDrop.boardAria: Drag and drop: items to classify and target zones
dragDrop.poolHint: Drag each item to the matching zone on the right.
dragDrop.zonesHint: Drop items here according to the expected type or category.

sortingLab.boardHint: Drag an item into a category, or tap the item then the category.
sortingLab.boardHintHidden: Group names are hidden: discover the grouping rule.

knowledgeBridges.boardAria: Knowledge bridges: sources and targets to link
knowledgeBridges.missionHint: Link each left-hand item to the matching item on the right.
knowledgeBridges.boardHint: Tap a left item, then its target on the right. Each target can be used only once.

sequenceFrieze.boardHint: Drag cards into positions, or tap a card then a slot. Tap two placed cards to swap them.
sequenceFrieze.selectSlotHint: Position selected — tap another card to swap.

missingFragment.boardAria: Missing fragment: structure and fragment reserve
missingFragment.boardHint: Complete the structure by placing the right fragments into the gaps, then submit.
missingFragment.boardHintLearning: Place a fragment into a gap: a correct placement locks, an incorrect one returns to the reserve.

transformAtelier.boardAria: Transformation workshop: source, tools and result
transformAtelier.boardHint: Choose the operation that reaches the target form without altering the invariant.
transformAtelier.boardHintChain: Apply transformations in the right order until you reach the target form.

matching.boardAria: Match each prompt to a unique answer
matching.boardHint: Click the pill that matches each item. Each answer can only be used once.

memory.boardAria: Memory game: match problems and solutions
memory.boardHint: Flip one card, then another (or wait 2 s). A correct pair shares the same color and disappears; otherwise both cards flip back.

investigation.boardAria: Investigation: validate statements about the concept
investigation.boardHint: For each statement, choose True or False.

comparator.boardHint: Compare the two items criterion by criterion, justify, then pick a synthesis.
comparator.noJustifications: No justification available for this criterion.

familyLegend.title: Cognitive family colors
familyLegend.intro: Each card is one specific operation (a verb: Identify, Associate…). That operation — not the family — is what generates and scores a challenge.
familyLegend.role: A family is a reading aid: it groups related operations and tints the cards. The operations listed below are taken from the catalog.
